sources.source: Planning Data tree preservation order dataset
sources.authority: Local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 107,674 tree preservation orders from 74 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-21, with some MHCLG-created data pending authoritative replacement.
sources.quality_effect: A TPO is a legal protection trigger, but the order document, active status and linked tree or zone geometry must be verified before parcel use.

sources.source: Planning Data tree preservation zone dataset
sources.authority: Local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 94,023 tree-preservation zones from 79 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22, and the service describes the data as coming from a small group used to develop the specification.
sources.quality_effect: The polygon can locate protected tree groups or woodlands, but national completeness, linked-order status and mixed origin prevent sole-source parcel scoring.

sources.authority: Local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 246,206 protected-tree records from 72 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-19, with some MHCLG-created data pending replacement.
sources.quality_effect: Individual-tree records provide point or geometry context but require linked TPO, current status, species or works context and exact parcel relation.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 44,373 ancient woodlands from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22, new data was last found on 2026-03-21, and origin is fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: Ancient-woodland intersection is strong environmental constraint evidence, but exact parcel relation and current Natural England guidance remain required.

sources.source: Planning Data ancient woodland status dataset
sources.verified_fact: The category dataset contains two status codes, ASNW and PAWS; the collector last ran on 2026-07-08 and new data was last found on 2025-05-08.
sources.quality_effect: The status vocabulary classifies woodland records but is not itself site geometry or a parcel measurement.

sources.source: Planning Data local nature reserve dataset
sources.authority: Natural England / local authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 1,727 local nature reserves from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-08 and new data was last found on 2026-06-19, with some MHCLG-created data.
sources.quality_effect: LNR geometry is statutory environmental context, but designation status, mixed origin and exact parcel intersection must be verified.

sources.source: Planning Data national nature reserve dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 224 national nature reserves from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2026-04-22, with some MHCLG-created data.
sources.quality_effect: NNR geometry is high-value conservation context, but current declaration status and exact parcel relation remain required.

sources.source: Planning Data site of special scientific interest dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 4,128 SSSIs from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2026-04-23, with some MHCLG-created data.
sources.quality_effect: SSSI intersection is nationally protected environmental evidence, but exact relation and current Natural England readback are required before scoring.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 20,150 scheduled monuments from one provider; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22, and the page directs users to Historic England for the most current GIS data.
sources.quality_effect: Scheduled-monument geometry is a legal heritage constraint, but current Historic England status and exact parcel relation must be confirmed.

sources.source: Planning Data listed building outline dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 121,057 outlines from 93 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-18. The service states that coverage is incomplete, outlines do not consistently show curtilage, and data is MHCLG-created.
sources.quality_effect: The outline is an indicative screening geometry and cannot be treated as legal curtilage or complete national coverage.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 100,627 planning applications from six providers; collector and new-data dates are 2025-09-17, and the data is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
sources.quality_effect: Applications can support market and precedent research, but incomplete provider coverage, stale collection and non-authoritative origin block sole-source candidate promotion.

sources.source: Planning Data planning application condition dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 5,305 conditions from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22, new data was last found on 2025-06-21, and the data is MHCLG-created.
sources.quality_effect: Conditions require linkage to a specific live application or permission and authoritative decision documents before use.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset reports 71 waste plans from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-04-10 and new data was last found on 2026-03-12, with MHCLG-created origin pending authoritative replacement.
sources.quality_effect: Plan metadata can route mineral and waste policy research, but authoritative plan documents, current adoption status and boundary linkage remain required.
